English.Char_Desc_80: Free personal bank account manager, simple but offers advanced features
English.Char_Desc_250: Yapbam is a free personal bank account manager, open source, cross-platform, portable. It is simple to use but offers advanced features: Balance history, entry wizard, excel Import/export, periodical transactions, statistics, budget, etc...
English.Char_Desc_450: Yapbam is a free personal bank account manager, open source, cross-platform, portable. It is simple to use but offers enhanced features: Balance history, entry wizard, excel import/export, periodical transactions, statistics, budget view, filtering, alerts, currency converter, etc. ...
English.Char_Desc_2000: Yapbam is a free personal bank account manager, open source, cross platform (runs on Windows, Mac, Linux), portable (it can be installed on USB key). It offers advanced features but is easy to use. The program lets you import your banking transactions from your old account manager or from statements provided by your bank. It edits your transactions quickly through a wizard entry and automatically generates your periodic transactions (payroll, taxes, etc.). Yapbam builds the history of your balance and alerts you when it will become negative. It instantly produces charts on the distribution of your expenses and a budget view of them. It also offers a currency converter connected through the Internet to official rates of the ECB (European Central Bank).
